start_message: 👋 Hello! I’m Lentagram, a bot for personal news feeds. What I can do: • Create themed feeds (channel collections) • Watch new posts from added channels • Filter posts by meaning with AI • Switch between feeds to show only the posts you need Start by creating your first feed 👇
language_description: Choose the language for bot menus, buttons, and service messages:
feed_not_found_deleted: ⚠️ Feed not found — it may have already been deleted.
no_posts_in_feed:
📭 There are no posts in this feed yet.
New posts will arrive automatically.
help_text: 📖 How to use Lentagram Switching feeds • Tap “🔴 Showing: ...” in the main menu • Choose one feed to receive only its posts • Or choose “ALL feeds” to receive posts from all feeds • When switching, I’ll show the latest 5 posts Creating a feed 1. Tap “➕ Create feed” 2. Enter a name and topic Adding channels • Send @username one by one, then tap “Finish” Commands /start — main menu /feeds — feed list /clear — clear chat /help — this help
clear_chat_title: 🧹 Clear chat Choose a period: 📅 Today — I’ll delete messages from the last 24 hours 🗑 All time — I’ll delete everything possible (Telegram limit: up to 48 hours) ⚠️ Only bot messages are deleted. Your messages remain.
create_feed_prompt: ✨ Create feed Think of a name. For example: “IT News”, “Crypto”, “Daily memes”. 📝 Send the name in one message:
feed_name_empty: ❌ The name can’t be empty. Try again.
filters_ready: ✨ Feed: {feed_name} 🤖 I prepared AI filter options:
feed_creation_lost: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Start feed creation again.
no_feeds: 📭 You don’t have any feeds yet
feeds_load_error: ⚠️ Couldn’t load feeds. Try again a bit later.
add_channels_choose:
📥 Adding channels to feed “{feed_name}”

Choose a method:
manual_add_prompt:
📥 Adding channels manually

Send @username, links (t.me/xxx), or forward a post from a channel.
You can send several separated by commas.

When finished, tap “✅ Finish”
feed_context_lost: ⚠️ Lost feed information. Start again from “My feeds”.
forward_channel_only: ⚠️ Forward a post from a channel, not a chat.
feed_channels_empty: 📡 Channels in feed “{feed_name}” 📭 No channels added yet. Add the first one to start receiving posts.
add_more_channels_prompt:
📥 Adding more channels to “{feed_name}”.

Send @username, links (t.me/xxx), or forward a post from a channel.
You can send several separated by commas.

When finished, tap “✅ Finish”
search_channels_prompt: 🔍 Channel search Enter a keyword or phrase — I’ll search Telegram channels. Examples: • seattle news • cryptocurrency • humor ⚠️ Search uses Telegram, so results may be limited.
search_not_found:
😕 Nothing found.

Try:
• Different keywords
• A more general query
• Or add a channel directly by @username
private_channel_no_username: ⚠️ This is a private channel without @username. Add it by link (t.me/...) or @username manually through the menu.
quick_add_where: 📥 Where should I add this channel?
bot_temporarily_unavailable: ⚠️ Bot is temporarily unavailable, try later
filter_not_set: (filter not set — all posts are shown)
edit_filter_prompt: ✏️ Editing filter “{feed_name}” Current filter (tap to copy): {filter_text} Send the new filter text in one message — it will fully replace the current one. You can copy the text above and change a few words.
filter_empty_retry: ❌ Filter can’t be empty. Try again.
filter_save_failed: ⚠️ Couldn’t save filter — feed not found or already deleted.
filters_ready_ai: ✨ Feed: {feed_name} 🤖 I prepared AI filter options:
filters_ready_fallback: ✨ Feed: {feed_name} ⚠️ AI analysis is temporarily unavailable. Possible reasons: • AI request limit was reached • temporary provider error • connection issue I prepared standard filters so you can continue:
